description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the Vedar remote MCP server (vedarai.ru): Kamchatka tours with live availability, safety status of places, stays, transfers, weather and trip plans; booking requests are confirmed by a human.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Vedar（vedarai.ru）远程 MCP 服务器：堪察加旅游项目与实时余位、地点安全状况、住宿、包车接送、天气和行程规划；预订申请由人工确认。
